dct_description_sm: Data on lower boundary layer structure were obtained from a micrometeorological tower erected near the BARC building at Barrow, Alaska to improve our understanding of atmospheric processes. Data were collected as part of an intensive field campaign as part of the international OASIS-09 project (see www.OASIShome.net). Complementary data are available in the Polar Data Catalogue, CCIN Reference Number 1839.
dct_title_s: OASIS-CANADA Barrow-09 Tower Study: Atmospheric micrometeorology study during the international OASIS-09 campaign near Barrow, Alaska
